title: Cross-solver agreement test helper (ECOS vs Clarabel)
goal: The SOCP is convex, so ECOS and Clarabel must reach the same global optimum. Add a solver switch outside the guidance core so a Z0 test can later assert agreement.
acceptance: A function in analysis/solver_compare.py solves the RTLS and ASDS scenarios with both ECOS and Clarabel and returns fuel cost for each
Running `python -m analysis.solver_compare` prints both costs per scenario; relative difference < 0.5%
No file in Z0 or Z1 is modified; fast and full oracle stay green
